He stated the route was extremely dangerous, with his vehicle targeted twice by enemy UAVs. Due to constant aerial threats, movement required cover. Attacks were conducted by Ukrainian Hornet drones controlled via the Starlink satellite system. Tragedy was avoided: both drones were spotted in time and successfully shot down by mobile fire group fighters escorting the column. @Slavyangrad
